complexity theory with a specific complexity-theoretic object (SAT, resolution

  2. The linkage (field_A × field_B) must be one you believe has <5 papers.
  3. The conjecture must be TESTABLE on instances of size n ≤ 40 in < 240 seconds
     of pure Python (no external solvers allowed; small DPLL is fine). Use
     30 random seeds for statistical robustness.
  4. Stated as a concrete quantitative relation (e.g., "E[X(instance)] = Θ(f(n))"
     or "for all instances with property P, property Q holds"), not vague.
  5. Give a falsifier-friendly formulation (one counterexample refutes it).
  6. MUST include a CONSTRUCTIVE MAPPING: a concrete, coded-in-50-lines-of-python

     cohomology, motives, Langlands dual, etc.) without a computational shortcut,
     REJECT this idea and pick another. Example of GOOD: "compute the

information theory on resolution (SEC-MI, done), Ollivier-Ricci on SAT graphs
